id.title: Layanan Freight Forwarding FCL, Air Freight, PPJK & Project Cargo | GAEKS Freight
id.description: Jelajahi layanan GAEKS Freight: pengiriman laut FCL & LCL, air freight ekspor/impor, jasa PPJK customs clearance, undername impor & PI besi baja, penyediaan kapal RORO & breakbulk, project cargo, trucking, dan pergudangan.

en.title: Freight Forwarding, Customs Clearance & Vessel Services | GAEKS Freight
en.description: Explore GAEKS Freight services in Indonesia: FCL & LCL ocean freight, air freight export/import, PPJK customs clearance, undername import & Import Approval (PI), RORO & breakbulk sourcing, project cargo, trucking, and warehousing.
en.heading: Choose the right cargo handling for your shipment.
en.body: International ocean and air freight, PPJK customs brokerage, import licensing support, RORO and breakbulk sourcing, inland trucking, and port warehousing under unified operational coordination.

id.title: Rute dan Jadwal Pengiriman Laut & Udara Indonesia | GAEKS Freight
id.description: Jelajahi koridor pelabuhan dan bandara utama Asia, Eropa, dan Amerika menuju Jakarta, Semarang, dan Surabaya untuk pengiriman FCL, LCL, dan kargo udara.
id.heading: Rute dan jadwal pengiriman laut serta udara.
id.body: Koridor dipilih berdasarkan asal, tujuan, jenis komoditas, target waktu, dan kesiapan dokumen. Waktu tempuh bersifat indikatif dan dikonfirmasi bersama jadwal aktual saat pemesanan.

id.title: Kalkulator Kargo CBM & Berat Volumetrik Air Freight | GAEKS Freight
id.description: Hitung kubikasi CBM kontainer FCL/LCL dan berat volumetrik air freight (chargeable weight) secara akurat sebelum meminta penawaran pengiriman.
id.heading: Kalkulator CBM dan berat volumetrik kargo.
id.body: Hitung volume CBM untuk FCL/LCL (P x L x T / 1.000.000) serta berat volumetrik udara (P x L x T / 6.000) untuk menentukan chargeable weight dan memilih moda pengiriman yang tepat.

id.title: Tarif Pengiriman FCL, LCL & Air Freight Indonesia | GAEKS Freight
id.description: Informasi faktor tarif pengiriman laut FCL, konsolidasi LCL, kargo udara air freight, dan kepabeanan PPJK sesuai rute, komoditas, serta jadwal pengiriman aktual.
id.heading: Rencanakan pengiriman Anda dengan informasi tarif yang tepat.
id.body: Tarif freight disesuaikan dengan rute asal-tujuan, moda, dimensi dan berat kargo, Incoterms, serta jadwal aktual. Siapkan data awal Anda untuk menerima penawaran tertulis.

en.title: Ocean FCL, LCL & Air Freight Rate Information | GAEKS Freight
en.description: Understand rate factors and request tailored FCL ocean freight, LCL consolidation, air freight, and PPJK customs brokerage quotations from GAEKS Freight Indonesia.
en.heading: Plan your shipment with clear freight rate guidance.
en.body: Freight quotations depend on origin-destination corridor, transport mode, cargo weight and volume, Incoterms, and live carrier capacity. Share your shipment brief to receive a verified quotation.

id.title: Maskapai Kargo Udara dan Perusahaan Pelayaran | GAEKS Freight
